subset_note: Real MIT Supercloud data, random subset of 104 labelled jobs (4 per label, single-file jobs of 2-40 MB), chronological job split 73/16/15. LSTMs: 2 seeds, max 10 epochs (full design: 5 seeds, 20 epochs). Not the full 3,430-job experiment.
e2_note: Simulated control response on the first 60 min of each of the 30 test-split GPU traces.
label: SUBSET RUN: 104 real MIT Supercloud labelled jobs (4 per label); test split = 15 jobs (30 GPU series, first 60 min of each); ML forecaster = L0 LSTM selected by validation MAE
note: Controller metrics are SIMULATED (twin driven by REAL measured power). Cooling-side twin parameters are ASSUMED; thermal inertia is fitted on real data. Not physical measurements.
threshold_rule: steady-state T_j at 250 W with valve 0.5
